Implement the following API.

File contract: Return Solution.java defining public final class Solution.
Required API: public static String booleanFlags(String input)
Behavior: Parse comma-separated key=true or key=false records. Keys use ASCII [a-z][a-z0-9]*(?:-[a-z0-9]+)* and must be unique. Reject empty input or malformed records. Return enabled keys in ASCII lexicographic order joined by commas; an all-false input returns the empty string.
Visible example: cache=true,trace=false,debug=true returns cache,debug.

Return only the complete source file; do not include Markdown fences or prose.

reference.code: import java.util.*;public final class Solution{public static String booleanFlags(String s){if(s.isEmpty())return null;var d=new HashMap<String,Boolean>();for(String r:s.split(",",-1)){String[]p=r.split("=",-1);if(p.length!=2||!p[0].matches("[a-z][a-z0-9]*(?:-[a-z0-9]+)*")||(!p[1].equals("true")&&!p[1].equals("false"))||d.putIfAbsent(p[0],p[1].equals("true"))!=null)return null;}return d.entrySet().stream().filter(Map.Entry::getValue).map(Map.Entry::getKey).sorted().collect(java.util.stream.Collectors.joining(","));}}
